verdict.rationale: Folk's own materials list in-product AI features: 'Generate AI-powered custom fields' and 'AI Assistants' as a pricing-tier feature. That suggests AI-derived information on records inside the product, but neither item describes insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The MCP use cases run in external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) and do not count as in-product. missing for 10: documentation of what the AI assistants actually generate, evidence of insights or suggestions surfaced from workspace data, detail on how AI custom fields work, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
